mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% triggers labor market stress, leading to reduced corporate investment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or t-test p > 0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (RSAFS) indicates robust demand, which drives equity valuations higher and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p < 0.05) when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are rising simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals higher borrowing costs, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% in the tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 points reflects expanding economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in job openings (PAYEMS) below 1.2 million signals labor market contraction, reducing corporate investment and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when PAYEMS drops below 1.2M.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing market activity (HOUST) indicates strong demand, which drives equity valuations higher and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p < 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, sustained industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 points signals economic resilience, boosting investor confidence and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO is above 105 in post-shock regime.
